model: Spherical Earth, circular two-body orbit and uniform Earth rotation, with arbitrary phase. Nominal SSO inclination is used without J2 precession. GEO is fixed in the Earth frame. This is a teaching model, not an ephemeris, pass prediction, tasking plan, cloud-free revisit forecast or calibrated sensor simulator.

presets.label: Sentinel-5P · TROPOMI NO₂
presets.sampling: Illustrative 3.5 × 5.5 km nadir NO₂ footprint; actual size varies across track, processing version and acquisition date.
presets.temporal: Near-daily global sampling design; 16-day ground-track cycle. Clouds, QA, viewing geometry and product latency affect usable observations.
presets.limitations: A retrieved atmospheric column is not a surface concentration. A modeled swath crossing does not establish a valid NO₂ retrieval.

presets.label: Aura · OMI NO₂
presets.sampling: Nominal 13 × 24 km nadir VIS/UV-2 footprint, shown with illustrative orientation. Pixel geometry varies across track.
presets.temporal: Daily global sampling design; 16-day ground-track repeat. Row-anomaly flags, clouds, QA and instrument status affect usable data.
presets.limitations: These are nominal acquisition-era geometry values; the model does not verify present spacecraft or instrument operations.

presets.label: Intelsat 40e · TEMPO NO₂
presets.sampling: Nominal 2.0 × 4.75 km Level-2 footprint, drawn in illustrative orientation. Off-nadir geometry changes the actual footprint; Level-3 grids are different.
presets.temporal: Hourly daytime scans over North America. Scan schedule, daylight, clouds and QA are not simulated.
presets.limitations: The dashed rectangle is the provider's advertised collection envelope, not its sensor field of view or a promise of coverage. A geometric horizon test alone does not establish an observation.

presets.label: Landsat 8 · OLI multispectral
presets.sampling: 30 m multispectral sampling. Panchromatic is 15 m; TIRS is 100 m native, often distributed on a 30 m grid.
presets.temporal: 16-day single-platform repeat; Landsat 9 provides an offset. Usable optical revisit depends on clouds, acquisition plans and QA.
presets.limitations: The displayed strip is a simplified nadir 60-second swath segment, not a real Landsat scene or an acquisition schedule.

heat.label: Landsat 8 / TIRS surface heat
heat.sampling: 100 m native thermal sampling for this heat question. A distributed 30 m surface-temperature grid does not create 30 m thermal detail; OLI multispectral bands are a different measurement.

presets.label: Landsat 9 · OLI-2 multispectral
presets.sampling: 30 m multispectral sampling; 15 m panchromatic. TIRS-2 native thermal sampling is 100 m.
presets.temporal: 16-day repeat for this platform; the Landsat 8/9 pair is nominally offset by eight days.
presets.limitations: Repeat is not a guarantee of an image over this box, clear skies, product delivery or identical viewing conditions.

heat.label: Landsat 9 / TIRS-2 surface heat
heat.sampling: 100 m native thermal sampling for this heat question. A distributed 30 m surface-temperature grid does not create 30 m thermal detail; OLI multispectral bands are a different measurement.

presets.label: Sentinel-2B · MSI
presets.sampling: 10 m for selected MSI bands; other bands are sampled at 20 or 60 m. Band selection matters.
presets.temporal: 10-day single-platform repeat. Nominal B/C pairing shortens revisit; clouds and observation planning affect usable imagery.
presets.limitations: A swath intersection is a geometric opportunity in this arbitrary-phase model, not a forecast or a cloud-free observation.

presets.label: Sentinel-2C · MSI
presets.sampling: 10, 20 or 60 m by band; the illustration selects a 10 m band.
presets.temporal: 10-day single-platform repeat; B/C pairing has a nominal five-day revisit, subject to observation conditions.
presets.limitations: The example Earth Search collection summary names 2A/2B. Confirm 2C availability in actual Items or choose another provider; the model is independent of archive availability.

presets.label: Sentinel-1C · C-SAR IW
presets.sampling: Illustrative 10 m output grid. IW native resolution is about 5 × 20 m in single-look geometry; output spacing is not resolution.
presets.temporal: 12-day single-platform repeat; acquisition mode, pointing, observation plan and constellation configuration affect sampling.
presets.limitations: Real SAR is side-looking. The symmetric nadir strip here only teaches swath-width/area relationships and cannot represent an actual SAR access window or footprint.
